lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Monday's Town Council meeting, where second reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code is up for a vote — amendments to the Land Use Code on landscaping, trees, and historic review that would lock in the town's wildfire standards going forward. The Housing Authority also meets Monday to work through a tricky primary-residency policy question for dependents of multiple custodial parents, and Wednesday's Planning and Zoning session takes up three Town-owned development projects in the Accommodations 2 zone, including the Carhenge Redevelopment at 700 W Pacific. Around it all, Shakespeare in the Park runs through Thursday and the free Oak Street Park summer show series kicks off Thursday night.

notable.stake: Final vote on wildfire code changes to landscaping and historic review standards.
New policy on primary residency for dependents of multiple custodial parents.
Public review of three Town-owned development projects, including Carhenge redevelopment.
Public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive liquor permit — anyone can comment.
